blocks.html: Robinsons Malls is inviting all Pokémon Go players to catch 'em all at the longest Lure Party this weekend. The first wave will happen on August 12-14 starting 12nn to 7pm at selected Robinsons Malls "Wear your Team Colors and meet up with other team members at the different Pokémon hotspots in our malls,” said Eunice Gonzalez, Marketing Director for Robinsons Malls. “This weekend, we will activate multiple lures for the Pokéstops and trainers from all levels can come join the fun,” added Gonzalez, “They can upload their catch on Facebook, tag @RobinsonsMalls and add the hashtags #CatchEmAllatRobinsonsMalls and #PokemonGoPH for a chance to win GCs” Malls included are: Robinsons Place Manila | Robinsons Galleria | Robinsons Magnolia | Forum Robinsons | Robinsons Starmills | Robinsons Place Malolos | Robinsons Place Gen Trias | Robinsons Place Las Pinas | Robinsons Place Antipolo | Summit Ridge Promenade
